artifacts.summary: 7-phase plan transcribing four Comparator-on-NixOS fixes (landrun shim with TMPDIR/git-lib/ELF-interpreter grants, pinned-toolchain PATH ordering with elan-wrapper unwrapping, outer landrun, git pre-flight probe) plus four documentation-only findings into the lean extension source store, with regression coverage, a new dependency-tracing pattern file, and a .claude/ redeploy.

memory_candidates.content: When a research report grounds an implementation plan in a reference implementation that lives OUTSIDE the repository being changed, the reference must be re-read live at plan time -- not trusted from the report's quoted excerpts and line numbers. Concrete instance: a report written 2026-09-17 cited framed_channel/recheck-comparator.sh, recheck-revs.sh and comparator-configs.sh at repository-root paths; by plan time all three had moved (into scripts/ and scripts/lib/), and the reference landrun shim had grown three mechanisms the report never mentions (an ELF-interpreter --rox grant for nix-ld, an in-shim PATH prepend because `lake env` reorders PATH, and a multi-grant RWX hook). A plan built on the report alone would have shipped an incomplete transcription that still failed on the host. The durable planning practice: for any cross-repository reference, spend one grounding read per named reference file before decomposing phases, and make every phase's first task a re-read of the live file by NAME rather than by line number.
